verdict.rationale: Unit is a financial-infrastructure platform with a Dashboard, APIs and components, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics collection or any opt-out control. Its SOC 2 and PCI DSS compliance claims are an adjacent security posture, not a user-facing telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
